notes: Single source of truth for the database spreadsheet, the Apps Script backend and the TypeScript types.
Timestamps are plain text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm' in plant-local time (no time zone). Dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Date/timestamp columns must be formatted as Plain Text in the sheet so Google Sheets never converts them.
Original upload text (code_raw, reason_raw) is always kept next to resolved ids.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Scheduled hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Calendar hours of the period x scheduled hours per day ÷ 24 (today 24 h a day, 7 days a week)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Available RRHH = days in month x 24
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same today. Decide whether an area that is not needed (e.g. a mill with full silos) is still scheduled.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Stoppage hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Hours stopped in the period; stops that overlap in one area are counted once
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: SUMIFS of TOTAL STOPPAGE DURATION (h) - overlapping rows are added twice
kpiDefinitionSeeds.app_formula: Merged per area, so overlaps count once (priority PL > INC > CIR)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: overlaps counted once.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Running hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Scheduled hours − stoppage hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Available RRHH − Stoppage Time
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same idea. Later compare with DCS running hours (see RH_DCS) as a data check.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Incident hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Hours of stops with criticality INC (PRO, MEC, ELE, AUT)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: SUMIFS ... CRITICALITY = "INC"
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Planned hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Hours of planned stops (PL)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: SUMIFS ... classification PL
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Circumstantial hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Hours of circumstantial stops (CIR: power cut, gas or water shortage, full silos ...)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: SUMIFS ... classification CIR
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Stop frequency (failures)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Number of failure events: Freq = 1, Failure = YES and not PL or CIR
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: COUNTIFS Failure = "YES" (every row, including continuation rows and PL/CIR rows marked YES)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: app rule (Freq = 1, Failure = YES, not PL/CIR).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Utilization factor (UF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Running hours ÷ scheduled hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Run ÷ (Run + Stop) = Run ÷ RRHH
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: ratio of sums.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Reliability factor (RF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Running hours ÷ (running hours + incident hours)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: IFERROR(Run ÷ (Run + INC), 0)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: no value (—) when there is nothing to divide.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Equipment availability (EA)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: (Running hours + circumstantial hours) ÷ scheduled hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: (Run + CIR) ÷ (Run + Stop)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as NRS: planned stops count as lost time.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Mean time between failures (MTBF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Running hours ÷ failure events
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: IFERROR(Run ÷ Stop Frequency, MTBF TARGET)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.app_formula: Run ÷ failure events; no failures = no value
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: "no failures" instead of the target.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Mean time to repair (MTTR)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Failure-event hours ÷ failure events
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: IFERROR(INC hours ÷ Stop Frequency, MTTR TARGET)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.app_formula: Duration of failure events ÷ failure events
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: failure-event hours ÷ failure events (same events as MTBF). Incident hours stay visible as INC_H.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Production
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Tons produced by the area in the period (DCS weigh feeders + recorded correction)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: CR: crusher feed + correction. RM: weigh feeders split OPC/SRC by the mix of the day, dry basis. FM: WF450 + WF550 by coal/petcoke mix. K: see CLK_T. CM: weigh feeders to each silo x running-hour factor
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Each area keeps the NRS method; every correction gets a reason and an approver (production_corrections).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker production
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: (Kiln feed + correction) ÷ clinker factor + ash from fuels
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Prod WO Ash = (kiln feed + correction ...) ÷ CF (PLG-CF, Manual-CF or Calculated-CF); Prod = Prod WO Ash + fuel ash tons
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Agree which clinker factor is used and who may change it; store it per day with its source.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Running hours (DCS)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Running hours counted by the DCS + recorded correction
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Tag + correction table
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Compare every day with RUN_H from the stoppage log; a gap above a set limit raises a data check.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Production rate
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Production ÷ DCS running hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Prod ÷ R H (0 when RH = 0)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Ratio of sums for month and year.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Performance factor (PF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Actual rate ÷ target rate
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Actual rate ÷ target rate
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Target rate per area and month in kpi_targets.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: UF x PF x quality rate
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Optional, still open: needs an agreed quality rate (e.g. 1 − isolated clinker ÷ clinker).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Specific power consumption (SPC)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Total power (process + auxiliary) x 1000 ÷ production
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Total Pwr x 1000 ÷ Prod; kiln sets values above 100 to 0
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: flag above the limit, never 0.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Specific heat consumption (SHC)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: (Fossil heat + alternative-fuel heat) ÷ (clinker x 1000)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: SUM(fossil, AF heat) ÷ (Prod x 1000); values above 1500 set to 0
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: flag above the limit, never 0; each fuel uses its own volume.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Thermal substitution rate (TSR)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Alternative-fuel heat ÷ total heat
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: AF heat ÷ (fossil + AF heat)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Specific water consumption (SWC)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Water (m³) x 1000 ÷ production
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Water x 1000 ÷ Prod; kiln sets values above 500 to 0
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed: flag above the limit, never 0.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Grinding aid dosage
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Grinding aid grams ÷ cement tons
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Dosage g/day ÷ tons to the silos
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker in cement
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Clinker tons ÷ cement tons
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: From the cement mill material balance
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agreed as proposed. Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Raw meal LSF standard deviation
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Standard deviation of the raw meal LSF results of the period
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Needs each sample (hourly), not daily averages: the spread of daily averages hides most of the variation.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Kiln feed LSF standard deviation
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Standard deviation of the kiln feed LSF results
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Main measure of kiln feed stability.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker free lime
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Average of the clinker free lime results
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Too high = under-burnt, too low = over-burnt (fuel lost).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker free lime in specification
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Results inside the free lime limits ÷ all results
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Limits from quality_parameters.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker C3S
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Average of the clinker C3S results
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Hot meal SO3
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Average of the hot meal SO3 results
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Early warning of build-up in the preheater.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Isolated (off-spec) clinker
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Isolated clinker tons ÷ clinker tons
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: From the kiln isolated-clinker value (NRS column Isolated Clinker).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Coal and petcoke fineness
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Average sieve residue of the ground coal / petcoke
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Cement Blaine standard deviation
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Standard deviation of the cement Blaine results, per product
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Per cement type: OPC and SRC must not be mixed in one figure.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Cement SO3 in specification
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Cement SO3 results inside the limits ÷ all results
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Quality conformance
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: All results inside their specification ÷ all results with a specification
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS (QCX daily averages only)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: One summary figure per area for the daily meeting.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker balance gap
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: (Clinker produced − clinker used by the mills − change in clinker stock) ÷ clinker produced
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Shows whether kiln production, mill consumption and stock agree; a large gap means one of them is wrong.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker stock cover
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Clinker stock ÷ average daily clinker use of the last 30 days
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Value at the end of the period.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Data on time
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Required values and reports entered and approved by their deadline ÷ all required
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Measures the reporting itself; shown per area and per duty.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Open data checks
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Data checks still open at the end of the period
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Not in NRS

checkRuleSeeds.name: Restart before stop
checkRuleSeeds.description: The restart time is before the stop time

checkRuleSeeds.name: No classification
checkRuleSeeds.description: PRO, MEC, ELE, AUT, PL or CIR is missing

checkRuleSeeds.name: Unknown equipment code
checkRuleSeeds.description: The code is not in the equipment master of the area

checkRuleSeeds.name: No reason
checkRuleSeeds.description: The reason is blank or not in the reason list

checkRuleSeeds.name: Overlapping stops
checkRuleSeeds.description: Two stops of one area overlap; the hours are counted once

checkRuleSeeds.name: Long open stop
checkRuleSeeds.description: A stop is still open after this many hours; the current shift confirms it is still stopped

checkRuleSeeds.name: Same stop twice
checkRuleSeeds.description: Same area, equipment and stop time entered twice

checkRuleSeeds.name: Value missing
checkRuleSeeds.description: A required production value is missing for the day

checkRuleSeeds.name: Negative value
checkRuleSeeds.description: Production, running hours, power, fuel and water cannot be negative

checkRuleSeeds.name: Outside the limits
checkRuleSeeds.description: The value is outside the min / max of the metric (production_metrics)

checkRuleSeeds.name: Running hours above the day
checkRuleSeeds.description: Running hours of an area above 24 h in a day

checkRuleSeeds.name: Production without running
checkRuleSeeds.description: Production above 0 while the running hours are 0, or the opposite

checkRuleSeeds.name: Rate far from target
checkRuleSeeds.description: Production rate differs from the target rate by more than this

checkRuleSeeds.name: Sudden change
checkRuleSeeds.description: The value changed by more than this against the day before

checkRuleSeeds.name: Large correction
checkRuleSeeds.description: A correction above this share of the raw value needs a reason and the production manager's approval

checkRuleSeeds.name: SPC above the limit
checkRuleSeeds.description: Specific power above the metric limit: flagged for review, never set to 0

checkRuleSeeds.name: Power without production
checkRuleSeeds.description: Process power used while production is 0 (standby losses)

checkRuleSeeds.name: Meters do not add up
checkRuleSeeds.description: Sum of the area meters differs from the transformer meters by more than this

checkRuleSeeds.name: SHC above the limit
checkRuleSeeds.description: Specific heat above the limit: flagged, never set to 0

checkRuleSeeds.name: No calorific value
checkRuleSeeds.description: A fuel was used on a day that has no calorific value

checkRuleSeeds.name: TSR outside 0-100 %
checkRuleSeeds.description: Thermal substitution rate below 0 or above 100 %

checkRuleSeeds.name: SWC above the limit
checkRuleSeeds.description: Specific water above the limit: flagged, never set to 0

checkRuleSeeds.name: Level outside 0-100 %
checkRuleSeeds.description: A silo or tank level below 0 or above 100 %

checkRuleSeeds.name: Level jump
checkRuleSeeds.description: A level changed by more than this in a day without matching production or use

checkRuleSeeds.name: Stock does not balance
checkRuleSeeds.description: Opening + in − out differs from closing stock by more than this

checkRuleSeeds.name: Clinker balance gap
checkRuleSeeds.description: Clinker produced − used by the mills − change in stock, above this share of production

checkRuleSeeds.name: Mix does not add up
checkRuleSeeds.description: Raw mix or cement recipe shares do not add up to 100 %

checkRuleSeeds.name: Clinker factor out of range
checkRuleSeeds.description: The clinker factor used for the day is outside this range (1.50 - 1.75)

checkRuleSeeds.name: Impossible result
checkRuleSeeds.description: Result outside the valid range of the parameter: most likely a typing or analyser error

checkRuleSeeds.name: Out of specification
checkRuleSeeds.description: Result outside the specification limits; counted in the in-spec KPIs and shown in the daily meeting

checkRuleSeeds.name: Too few samples
checkRuleSeeds.description: Fewer results than samples_per_day while the area was running

checkRuleSeeds.name: Same value repeated
checkRuleSeeds.description: The same value this many times in a row: analyser or copy error

checkRuleSeeds.name: Results while stopped
checkRuleSeeds.description: Results recorded for an area that was stopped the whole day

checkRuleSeeds.name: Running hours disagree
checkRuleSeeds.description: DCS running hours differ from scheduled minus stoppage hours by more than this

checkRuleSeeds.name: Production during a stop
checkRuleSeeds.description: Production recorded while the stoppage log shows the area stopped the whole day

checkRuleSeeds.name: Report late
checkRuleSeeds.description: A shift report, production value or lab result is past its deadline
